day3_afternoon_start.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_start.text: *やっと終礼が終わった。金曜日の放課後…解放感と共に妙な緊張感がある。*

day3_afternoon_tension.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_tension.text: *教室の雰囲気が重い。さっきの昼休みのせいだろう…*

day3_afternoon_confrontation.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_confrontation.text: *ソヨンに廊下に連れ出された。表情が真剣だ。*

day3_afternoon_confrontation_2.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_confrontation_2.text: "お昼のことなんだけど…本当にみんなと週末の約束したの？"

day3_afternoon_confrontation_3.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_confrontation_3.text: *どう答えればいいんだろう…*
choices: 時間帯が違うから大丈夫と言う
ソヨンだけが本気だと言う

day3_afternoon_admit.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_admit.text: "…うん。ごめん。みんなに断れなくて…"

day3_afternoon_admit_react.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_admit_react.text: "…正直に言ってくれてありがとう。でも、嫌だよそういうの。"

day3_afternoon_admit_react_2.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_admit_react_2.text: "If I'm really special to you... only meet me. Otherwise, I have options too."

day3_afternoon_justify.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_justify.text: "The times are all different... so I thought I could meet everyone..."

day3_afternoon_lie_seoyeon.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_lie_seoyeon.text: "Seoyeon, you're the only one I'm sincere about. The others are just friends..."

day3_afternoon_lie_warning.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_lie_warning.text: *Seoyeon smiles. But... is this right? What should I tell the others?*

day3_afternoon_jealousy_check.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_jealousy_check.text: *The atmosphere was a bit weird during lunch... It should be fine, right?*

day3_afternoon_approach.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_approach.text: *As I stand up to pack my bag, someone approaches.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk.text: "About lunch... Sorry, I think I was being sensitive."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_2.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_2.text: "But honestly... seeing you close with Yuna or Dain bothers me a little."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_comfort.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_comfort.text: "...Really? Hearing that... I feel a bit relieved."

day3_afternoon_yuna_question.name: ユナ
day3_afternoon_yuna_question.text: "...Upset? No. I just... wanted to confirm."

day3_afternoon_yuna_warning.name: ユナ
day3_afternoon_yuna_warning.text: "Remember, {name}. If you lie to me... you know, right?"

day3_afternoon_dain_talk.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_talk.text: "Why didn't you include me at lunch?! I wanted to eat together too!"

day3_afternoon_dain_promise.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_promise.text: "Really?! Then I forgive you! Look forward to my spike!"

day3_afternoon_normal.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_normal.text: *A peaceful after school. Let me get ready to go home.*

day3_afternoon_transition.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_transition.text: *As I'm about to leave through the school gate...*

day3_afternoon_multiple_wait.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_multiple_wait.text: *Uh... why is everyone at the gate...?*

day3_afternoon_multiple_no_seoyeon.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_multiple_no_seoyeon.text: *Several people are standing at the school gate. Are they all waiting for me...?*

day3_afternoon_three_way_2.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_three_way_2.text: *Seoyeon and Yuna are glaring at each other. The atmosphere is tense.*

day3_afternoon_two_way_dain.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_two_way_dain.text: "Oh? Seoyeon's here too? I was gonna walk home with {name}!"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_walk_others.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_walk_others.text: *I feel eyes on my back... but right now, walking with Seoyeon feels nice.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_walk_yuna_reactio.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_walk_yuna_reactio.text: *Yuna is watching us from a distance. That look... is scary.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_walk.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_walk.text: "...Hey, {name}. Let's take the riverside path back. The sunset is beautiful today."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset.text: *The sunset reflects off the river, sparkling. Seoyeon's face glows with an orange tint — she looks radiant.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset_2.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset_2.text: *She suddenly stops and stands in front of me* "...{name}. Can I ask you something?"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset_3.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset_3.text: *Against the sunset backdrop, Seoyeon's eyes shine* "Tomorrow... you'll only meet me, right?"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_pinky.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_pinky.text: *Seoyeon holds out her pinky finger* "Then let's pinky promise. If you break it... you swallow ten thousand needles?"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_hand.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_hand.text: *Seoyeon's hand trembles before she grips mine tight* "...Dummy. What if someone sees us holding hands here."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_try.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_try.text: *Looking slightly disappointed, she forces a smile* "...Okay. You'll try, right?"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *Walking alongside Seoyeon down the riverside path as the sunset deepens.*
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_freetalk.context: ソヨンと夕焼けの川沿いを歩いている。ソヨンが「明日は私だけに会ってくれる？」と言い、指切り・手つなぎのスキンシップがあった。甘くてロマンチックな雰囲気。

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_walk_2.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_walk_2.text: "It's our time together, just the two of us. Right?"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_guilt.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_guilt.text: *...'Just the two of us'. My other plans flash through my mind.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_happy.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_happy.text: "Hehe, me too! See you tomorrow then! Sleep well!"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_angry.name: ソヨン
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_angry.text: "...Fine. We'll see this weekend who you really like."

day3_afternoon_yuna_talk_walk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_yuna_talk_walk.text: *Walking with Yuna down a quiet path. She doesn't say much, but the atmosphere is comfortable.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat.text: *A small cat is curled up by the roadside. Yuna suddenly stops.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_2.name: ユナ
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_2.text: *Quietly kneeling down to pet the cat* "...I'm glad you're with me."

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_3.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_3.text: *The way Yuna pets the cat... she looks so gentle.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_pat.name: ユナ
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_pat.text: *Our hands meet on top of the cat* "...Warm."

day3_afternoon_yuna_head_pat.name: ユナ
day3_afternoon_yuna_head_pat.text: *She freezes when I pat her head* "...You're petting me?"

day3_afternoon_yuna_head_pat_2.name: ユナ
day3_afternoon_yuna_head_pat_2.text: *Closing her eyes* "...Don't stop. Just a little more."

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_watch.name: ユナ
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_watch.text: *Holding the cat up* "...This one looks like you, {name}. Warm and... clueless."

day3_afternoon_yuna_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_yuna_freetalk.text: *Walking side by side with Yuna. Her expression is softer than usual.*
day3_afternoon_yuna_freetalk.context: ユナと一緒に猫を撫でた後の帰り道。ユナの表情がいつもより柔らかい。静かで心地よい雰囲気。

day3_afternoon_yuna_talk_walk_3.name: ユナ
day3_afternoon_yuna_talk_walk_3.text: "School back gate. 8 PM. Don't... be late."

day3_afternoon_yuna_warning_walk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_yuna_warning_walk.text: *There's a strange pressure in Yuna's voice.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_late_warning.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_yuna_late_warning.text: *Yuna's eyes seemed to flash oddly for a moment... Must be my imagination?*

day3_afternoon_dain_talk_walk.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_talk_walk.text: "Hey, {name}! See that convenience store? I'm thirsty!"

day3_afternoon_dain_store.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_dain_store.text: *Dain dashes to the convenience store. I follow and find her stopped at the ice cream section.*

day3_afternoon_dain_store_2.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_store_2.text: "You pick for me! If I pick, I'll want to buy everything..."

day3_afternoon_dain_ice_one.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_ice_one.text: *Taking the ice cream* "...Thanks. {name} is the best!"

day3_afternoon_dain_ice_share.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_ice_share.text: *Her face turns red at the idea of sharing* "Th-that's sharing?! That's an indirect kiss! N-no! It's just sharing!"

day3_afternoon_dain_park.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_dain_park.text: *Dain and I sit side by side on a park bench nearby. We eat ice cream while watching the sunset.*

day3_afternoon_dain_park_2.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_park_2.text: *Suddenly getting quiet* "...{name}. Actually, I couldn't sleep last night."

day3_afternoon_dain_park_3.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_park_3.text: "...You said you'd come to my practice tomorrow... You'll really come, right? You're not gonna stand me up?"

day3_afternoon_dain_pat.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_pat.text: *Patting her head makes Dain's face turn red* "Hey, I'm not a kid! ...But don't stop."

day3_afternoon_dain_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_dain_freetalk.text: *Eating ice cream and chatting with Dain on a park bench.*
day3_afternoon_dain_freetalk.context: ダインと公園のベンチでアイスクリームを分け合った後。ダインが「昨日寝れなかった」と真剣な一面を見せた。いつもの活発さの代わりに恥ずかしがっている。

day3_afternoon_dain_talk_walk_2.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_talk_walk_2.text: "I want to show you my cool side!"

day3_afternoon_dain_cheer.name: ダイン
day3_afternoon_dain_cheer.text: "Hehe... Hearing that makes me want to work even harder!"

day3_afternoon_reject_all.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_reject_all.text: "Sorry, I want to go alone today."

day3_afternoon_reject_reaction.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_reject_reaction.text: *Everyone's expressions harden. I can feel their disappointment.*

day3_afternoon_nobody_waiting.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_nobody_waiting.text: *...No one's here. Must've been my imagination. Silly me for getting my hopes up.*

day3_afternoon_alone_walk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_alone_walk.text: *I head home alone. I wonder what tomorrow will bring...*

day3_afternoon_single_wait.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_single_wait.text: *Someone is standing in front of the gate.*

day3_afternoon_teacher_wait.name: 担任先生
day3_afternoon_teacher_wait.text: "{name}, do you have a minute? Want me to give you a ride?"

day3_afternoon_teacher_ride.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_teacher_ride.text: *I got in the teacher's car. The road home is bathed in sunset.*

day3_afternoon_teacher_ride_2.name: 担任先生
day3_afternoon_teacher_ride_2.text: *Driving quietly* "...{name}. Being alone together like this... feels a bit strange."

day3_afternoon_teacher_ride_3.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_teacher_ride_3.text: *We stop at a red light. The teacher quietly touches the back of my hand.*
choices: *Quietly lean my head on her shoulder*

day3_afternoon_teacher_hold.name: 担任先生
day3_afternoon_teacher_hold.text: *The teacher holds her breath* "...When the light changes, I'm letting go. Promise."

day3_afternoon_teacher_stop.name: 担任先生
day3_afternoon_teacher_stop.text: *The teacher smiles wistfully* "...You're right. Teacher needs to come to her senses."

day3_afternoon_teacher_lean.name: 担任先生
day3_afternoon_teacher_lean.text: *Startled at first... then quietly strokes my hair* "...The light hasn't changed yet."

day3_afternoon_teacher_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_teacher_freetalk.text: *Riding in the teacher's car on the way home.*
day3_afternoon_teacher_freetalk.context: 担任先生の車の中で帰宅中。夕焼けの中で手を繋いだり肩に寄りかかったりした後。禁断の恋の甘さと罪悪感。

day3_afternoon_teacher_arrive.name: 担任先生
day3_afternoon_teacher_arrive.text: *Arriving at my house* "...You haven't forgotten our museum date on Sunday, right? I'll be looking forward to it."

day3_afternoon_nurse_wait.name: 保健先生
day3_afternoon_nurse_wait.text: "Oh my, {name}. I came out to leave and ran into you? Hehe."

day3_afternoon_nurse_walk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_nurse_walk.text: *Walking side by side with the nurse. She glances at the back of my hand.*

day3_afternoon_nurse_band.name: 保健先生
day3_afternoon_nurse_band.text: *She suddenly takes my hand and puts a band-aid on it* "...There's a scratch here? You didn't notice."

day3_afternoon_nurse_band_2.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_nurse_band_2.text: *There's no scratch... Did she just want to hold my hand?*

day3_afternoon_nurse_caught.name: 保健先生
day3_afternoon_nurse_caught.text: *Her face turns red as if caught* "...Hmm, sharp eyes? It's just... teacher's mark."

day3_afternoon_nurse_hold.name: 保健先生
day3_afternoon_nurse_hold.text: *Surprised, she stops... then holds on tight* "...Dangerous boy. Let's stay like this for ten seconds."

day3_afternoon_nurse_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_afternoon_nurse_freetalk.context: 保健先生との帰り道。先生がバンドエイドを口実に手を握った。禁断の恋のときめきと緊張感。

day3_afternoon_nurse_arrive.name: 保健先生
day3_afternoon_nurse_arrive.text: "Don't forget Sunday 7 PM, okay? I'll be waiting for you."
